cards.title: Sequence Limit
cards.description: Ordered states or estimates may approach a stable limiting value.

cards.title: Partial Sum
cards.description: Finite cumulative totals must be separated from infinite-series claims.

cards.title: Geometric Decay
cards.description: Repeated proportional effects converge only when the feedback factor is small enough.

cards.title: Stopping Rule
cards.description: A stopped computation is not automatically a converged computation.
